Make the server deployable as a public website

- Per-visitor anonymous player ids (httpOnly cookie) with isolated saves,
  sessions and API keys; optional shared server key (GS_SHARED_KEY=1)
- HOST/PORT from env, health check, per-player rate limit, input caps,
  serialized per-player mutations, idle session eviction, save-id validation
- Dockerfile + .dockerignore; docs/DEPLOY.md for Render, Fly.io and a VPS

LLM gateway, NL agents, saves, game server, browser client, tests

- packages/llm: Anthropic gateway (structured outputs via Zod, prompt caching,
  server-side refusal fallbacks, per-turn budget) + offline and scripted gateways
- packages/agents: intent parser (LLM with rule-based fallback), leader
  conversations grounded in the negotiation evaluator, group meetings with a
  deterministic floor manager and motions, commitment tracking, narrator,
  advisor and AI deliberation
- packages/persistence: SQLite campaign saves (snapshots, event log, reports,
  LLM log), rewind
- apps/server: Fastify game server; bring-your-own API key held in memory
- apps/client: React + MapLibre browser UI with narrative-first briefing,
  order briefs, diplomacy chats, programs, military, world and reports
- tests: determinism, invariants, save/load, authority, projects, adversarial
  'annex the world' evals, diplomacy validation

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01VnpC1e2VV6kdMc3BC5szPL

Engine core, simulation systems, Jan 2026 scenario and province map

- packages/schemas: closed action ontology (24 families) and LLM output contracts (Zod)
- packages/engine: deterministic simulation (economy, trade, commodities, politics,
  elections, military, warfare, projects, diplomacy, treaties, intelligence, events),
  validator pipeline with authority system, utility-AI nations with negotiation
  evaluator, monthly turn pipeline, fog-of-war player views
- packages/scenario: YAML/CSV scenario loader with validation and calibration
- data/scenarios/2026-01-01: 11 countries + Rest-of-World, Russia-Ukraine war,
  NATO/EU/UNSC/CSTO, sanctions, trade matrix, 234-province map
- tools/geo: reproducible Natural Earth province build
- apps/cli: headless simulation runner
